notes: The player and other players are never the subject of a past-tense verb or an agreeing adjective (zgradil/zgradila, pripravljen/pripravljena): present tense, impersonal or passive forms, or nouns are used instead.
Placeholders stay in the nominative: after a colon or in apposition to a declined noun (stavba vrste {building}); no preposition or case ending depends on them.
Plurals use one / two / few / other as Intl.PluralRules("sl") gives them (few also covers fractions).

Generated names are noun-first with a space (generatedNames: noun-first): second parts are nouns (Vrh, Prelaz, Dolina, Žerjav), first parts are invariant genitives written in lower case (groma, megle, polnoči): Prelaz groma, Žerjav polnoči.
Slovenian letters č š ž are outside Latin-1, so the language belongs in SYSTEM_FONT_LANGS (integration step).

The legal pages use the same informal ti as the game; they are translations for review, not legal advice. The Japanese statutory pages are fully translated, with their Japanese titles kept as link text on the support page.
Computer players' generated names (Kaito Mori) are stored text and stay in Latin letters.
